title: Tree Capacity and Splitting Isometries for Subinvariant Kernels
summary: Starting from a subinvariant positive definite kernel under a branching pullback, we attach to the resulting kernel sequence an electrical network on the word tree whose edge weights are the diagonal increments. The resulting effective resistance and capacity give explicit criteria and quantitative bounds for the diagonal growth, together with a matching upper bound under a mild level regularity condition.
